title: The 8 Best Exterior Wood Glue 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for exterior wood glue 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at exterior wood glue 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Titebond III Ultimate Wood Glue, 16 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: ANSI/HPVA Type I waterproof rating, full water immersion, FDA approved for indirect food contact, 25-minute clamp time.
strengths: ANSI Type I waterproof, the highest standardfor continuous water immersion
Bonds stronger than the wood when properly clamped and fitted
25-minute clamp time is faster than most waterproof PVA alternatives
Cleans up with water before cure, no solvent needed
limitations: Slightly more expensive than Titebond II
Not suitable for oily tropical hardwoods without surface preparation
features: ANSI/HPVA Type I waterproof rating, full water immersion
FDA approved for indirect food contact
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Titebond II Premium Wood Glue
products.blurb: Key specs: ANSI/HPVA Type II water-resistant, 30-minute clamp time, Sands without clogging.
strengths: ANSI Type II water-resistant, handles rain and occasional wetting well
Lower price than Titebond III, significant savings on large glue-ups
Excellent sanding behavior, same as standard Titebond products
30-minute clamp time gives adequate working time for most assemblies
limitations: ANSI Type II, not Type I, not rated for continuous water immersion
Not suitable for applications in constant contact with water (boat hulls, planters with standing water)
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: West System 105-A Epoxy Resin with 206-A Slow Hardener + Mini Pump Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Marine-grade waterproof epoxy, Low viscosity, penetrates and consolidates wood, Excellent adhesion on oily tropical hardwoods.
strengths: Marine-grade waterproofing used in boat building, the most demanding waterproof standard
Bonds teak, ipe, and other oily hardwoods that PVA cannot hold
Low viscosity penetrates degraded wood for structural repair and consolidation
Can be used as a waterproof coating on top of the wood as well as an adhesive
limitations: High price, significantly more expensive than PVA alternatives
Requires precise 5:1 mixing by weight or volume
Longer cure time than PVA, 12+ hours for handling strength
features: Low viscosity, penetrates and consolidates wood
Excellent adhesion on oily tropical hardwoods

products.name: Gorilla Original Gorilla Glue Waterproof
products.blurb: Key specs: 100% waterproof polyurethane, Expands 3x to fill gaps, Works on oily hardwoods.
strengths: 100% waterproof, suitable for outdoor and marine applications
Expanding formula fills gaps in rough or imprecise joinery
Works on oily tropical hardwoods where PVA fails
Bonds wood, stone, metal, and foam, versatile for mixed-material outdoor projects
limitations: Foam expansion requires cleanup, squeeze-out expands and must be removed before curing
Requires moisture to cure, wood or one surface must be dampened first
Expansion can shift joint alignment if parts are not well clamped

products.name: Gorilla 2 Part Epoxy, 5 Minute Set, .85 oz Syringe
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-minute working time, Waterproof after cure, Fills gaps up to 1/4 inch.
strengths: Dual syringe eliminates ratio errors, equal parts dispensed automatically
Waterproof after full cure, suitable for exterior repairs
Fills gaps that PVA cannot bridge, good for worn or imprecise outdoor joinery
5-minute set speeds up repair workflow
limitations: 5-minute open time too short for complex assemblies
Syringe does not reseal well, remainder cures in tip

products.name: Gorilla Wood Glue, 8 oz Bottle
products.blurb: Key specs: Water-resistant formula, 20–30 minute clamp time, Works on hardwood, softwood, composites.
strengths: Water-resistant bond handles light outdoor exposure
Natural color blends into light wood better than yellow PVA glues
Faster clamp time than many competitors
Widely available, convenient to buy locally
limitations: Water-resistant, not waterproof, not suitable for constant outdoor exposure
Not rated for ANSI Type I or Type II applications explicitly

products.name: Sika SikaBond Ultimate Grab Instant Polyurethane Adhesive, 10.1 fl oz
products.blurb: Key specs: Elastic flexible adhesive, Waterproof and UV resistant, Absorbs movement and vibration.
strengths: Elastic after cure, absorbs thermal wood movement without cracking the bond
UV resistant, maintains bond and color in direct sun exposure
Handles wood species that move significantly across seasons
No mixing required, single-component formula
limitations: Higher price than PVA and epoxy alternatives
Longer cure time, 24 hours minimum before light handling

products.name: PC Products PC-Woody Wood Repair Epoxy Paste, 12 oz Two-Part
products.blurb: Key specs: Epoxy paste for wood repair and restoration, Accepts nails and screws when cured, Stainable and paintable.
strengths: Specifically designed for outdoor wood repair, bonds to weathered, degraded, and rotted wood

Stains and paints to match surrounding wood
Industry standard for exterior trim and sill restoration

features: Epoxy paste for wood repair and restoration
